request_text: Hallo, bitte schicken Sie mir eine vollständige Kopie aller personenbezogenen Daten, die Sie zu meinem Konto gespeichert haben. Ich möchte mein Konto behalten.
Hola, necesito exportar todos mis pedidos y datos de perfil en un archivo CSV para llevarlos a otro servicio. No quiero cerrar la cuenta.
Je ne veux plus recevoir vos e-mails promotionnels. Merci de me désinscrire de la newsletter, mais ne supprimez surtout pas mon compte.
Please don't delete or close anything. I only need you to correct the phone number on my profile, the old one is wrong.
I changed the email on this account before deleting it. Please check that nothing tied to the old address was left behind, even in systems that do not display the email.
Non voglio solo disiscrivermi dalla newsletter: voglio che il mio account e tutti i miei dati personali vengano cancellati definitivamente.
